objects.taxonomy_description: A medium-sized mammal characterized by a distinctive facial mask and ringed tail, distinguishable from other procyonids and canids by specific visual markers.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Facial_Markings: Presence of a prominent black mask around the eyes contrasting with lighter fur on the face.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Tail_Pattern: Tail exhibits distinct alternating dark and light rings along its length.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Ear_Shape: Ears are rounded, relatively small, and set wide apart on the head without tufts.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Posture: Compact, robust body structure with short legs and a plantigrade stance often seen in climbing or foraging contexts.
